anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high, especially the 15-minute load average (11.16) which exceeds the number of cores (8), indicating potential CPU bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any opportunities or made adjustments recently, which may indicate a malfunction or misconfiguration.
Trading metrics show zero activity in terms of active trades, total profit/loss, and ROI, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review AI system configuration and logs to ensure it is functioning correctly and generating trading opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and market conditions to ensure they align with current market trends and are capable of generating trades.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations and user experience.
